title: DownloadRequest
description: The request that contains options for configuring the download of content

contentId.description: The unique Zywave identifier for the content.

fileId.description: The unique Zywave identifier for the file under the content.

convertToPDF.description: The flag that will convert the file from its native format to a PDF, ignored for inapplicable filetypes

mergeFields.description: The merge fields the download will attempt to find and replace in the body of the content, ignored for inapplicable filetypes

brandId.description: The brand for merge fields to apply to the content when downloading, ignored for inapplicable filetypes

themeId.description: The theme to apply to the content when downloading, ignored for inapplicable filetypes

skipApplyingTheme.description: Whether to skip applying the theme for this download, ignored for inapplicable filetypes

origin.description: The origin of the request, used for logging and analytics
